skill.name: pdf
skill.description: PDF processing toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating and modifying documents, converting pages to images, and filling PDF forms.
skill.summary: Process, analyze, convert, create, and fill PDF documents with guided Python and command-line workflows.
skill.author: ArtemisAI

security_audit.summary: Most external-command detections were false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, comments, and JavaScript template literals. Real risk remains from local filesystem reads and writes, caller-provided output paths, and documented command-line PDF workflows; no prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts accept caller-provided output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Write outputs only inside a dedicated workspace, reject absolute paths and parent-directory traversal, and ask before overwriting files.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs agents to run local PDF utilities and helper scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before command execution and show the exact command, input paths, and output paths first.

remediation.issue: Reference examples write files in the current working directory.
remediation.suggestion: Document that examples should run on copies of files and should write to a new output folder.

content.value_statement: PDF work often requires several tools and careful form handling. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through extraction, conversion, creation, and form filling.
actual_capabilities: Extract text and tables from PDF files using pypdf and pdfplumber workflows.
Create, merge, split, rotate, crop, encrypt, and watermark PDF documents.
Convert PDF pages to images for visual inspection and form analysis.
Detect fillable PDF fields and generate field information for structured form filling.
Fill fillable forms or add text annotations for non-fillable forms.
Reference command-line tools such as qpdf, pdftotext, pdfimages, and pdftk for advanced tasks.
limitations: The skill requires local Python libraries and optional command-line PDF tools to be installed.
Scanned PDFs need OCR tooling before reliable text extraction is possible.
Non-fillable form workflows depend on accurate visual bounding box selection.
The helper scripts can read and write local files, so paths should be reviewed before execution.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Forms
use_cases.description: Extract form fields, map user data to the correct fields, and produce a completed PDF for review.

use_cases.title: Extract Report Data
use_cases.description: Pull text, tables, and page images from PDF reports for downstream analysis or spreadsheet work.

use_cases.title: Assemble Document Packets
use_cases.description: Merge, split, rotate, watermark, or encrypt PDFs when preparing document bundles.

prompt_templates.title: Extract PDF Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to extract readable text from this PDF. Keep page breaks clear and note pages that appear scanned.

prompt_templates.title: Find Tables
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to inspect this PDF for tables. Extract each table with its page number and preserve column meaning.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to determine whether this form has fillable fields, then prepare a filled copy using the provided answers.

prompt_templates.title: Build a PDF Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to design a safe batch workflow that merges selected PDFs, extracts text, and writes outputs to a new workspace folder.

output_examples.input: A user provides a PDF report and asks for its tables.
output_examples.output: A page-by-page table summary with extracted rows, notes about merged cells, and warnings for unclear scans.

output_examples.input: A user provides a fillable application form and applicant details.
output_examples.output: A completed PDF copy, a short field mapping summary, and a list of fields that required manual review.

output_examples.input: A user provides several PDFs that need one packet.
output_examples.output: A merged document with page order notes, rotation corrections, and the final output path.

best_practices: Work on copies of user documents and keep generated files in a dedicated output folder.
Confirm file paths and overwrite behavior before running helper scripts or command-line tools.
Visually inspect validation images before filling non-fillable forms with annotations.
anti_patterns: Do not run PDF commands against broad directories without confirming the exact input set.
Do not write outputs over source PDFs or important files without explicit approval.
Do not trust extracted form field names without comparing them to the visible form layout.

faq.question: Can this skill fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports fillable fields and annotation-based filling for forms without built-in fields.

faq.question: Does it support scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, but scanned PDFs usually require OCR tools such as pytesseract and image conversion first.

faq.question: Can it extract tables?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pdfplumber workflows for extracting tables and preserving page context.

faq.question: Does it create new PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It references reportlab and pypdf workflows for creating and modifying PDF files.

faq.question: Are command-line tools required?
faq.answer: Some tasks use optional tools such as qpdf, pdftotext, pdfimages, or pdftk when they are available.

faq.question: What should users review before running it?
faq.answer: Users should review input paths, output paths, overwrite behavior, and any commands that process many files.
